newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oriental Land says initial offer price 8,050 yen.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Land says initial offer price 8,050 yen.

text.p: Oriental Land Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its initial share offer price had been set at 8,050 yen.
Oriental Land, which operates Tokyo Disneyland, will be listed on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on December 11.
Earlier, the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said that in the auction held on Wednesday, the weighted average price of Oriental Land's shares was 8,368 yen.
Besides the share offer through the auction, Oriental Land said it would sell 5.5 million new shares and an already issued 6.0 million shares.
The subscription period is from December 2 to December 4, it said.
